mintAuthority.summary: All six catalogued native RLUSD holder surfaces retain technically unbounded issuer mint authority. Ethereum and Base minters remain uniform 2-of-32, and Optimism, Ink and Unichain minters remain uniform 2-of-30. Each EVM role-admin/upgrader has the exact eleven-address weighted roster with quorum 7 (minimum three cryptographic signatures); deployed MultiSign signing logic was matched to verified executable source at each pinned controller. XRPL ledger 107364064 records quorum 25 with eight weight-24 and eighteen weight-1 signers (minimum two), disabled master and absent RegularKey. Weighted facts establish neither independent people nor per-key custody. Fifteen EVM native MultiSign controls and five NTT issuer administrations now carry complete conservative maximal-reach certificates from independently re-verified arbitrary-call source/runtime and signer pins. Every control capability is retained with adverse global unbounded semantics and zero delay; no exact downstream target census, deployment-local exclusion or liability partition is claimed. XRPL execution stays partial because the exact rippled 3.4.1 deployed-build/source identity remains unproved; NTT Guardian validation scopes stay partial. Five EVM burning-mode NTT/13-of-19 Guardian domains remain separately recorded under Bridge Risk. The issuer also names XRPL EVM Sidechain, which remains outside the supported catalog chain registry and prevents an exhaustive all-chain claim. The singular upgradeability object stays Ethereum-scoped; other deployment upgrade authorities remain separate controls.
